Use for non-interactive taxonomy or content-classification text only.

```jsx
<TaxonomyCapsule color="purple">Case study</TaxonomyCapsule>
<TaxonomyCapsule color="orange">Article</TaxonomyCapsule>
```

The component renders a plain `span`. Never add a link, click handler, button role, focus target, or pointer cursor. Use a square action or filter component when the user can interact with the element.
